responsibility: Machine-description file for the older ARC floating-point extensions (FPX/Argonaut/Quark) and their scheduler model. It describes FPX single- and double-precision instruction reservations, arithmetic and comparison patterns, lr/sr access to double registers, double-precision helper peepholes, and Quark SE-specific floating-point instructions, distinguishing extension-based floating point support from the newer hardware FPU patterns in fpu.md.
